newsitem.title: USA: Donnelly Corp creates technlogy ventures.
newsitem.headline: Donnelly Corp creates technlogy ventures.

text.p: Donnelly Corp, an automotive supplier, said Thursday it has formed two wholly owned technology ventures.

The two companies -- Information Products Inc and Donnelly Optics Inc -- have been established as independent operating units so that they will have more freedom and flexibility to develop and market their unique technologies, Donnelly said.
Information Products Inc is based in Holland, Mich., and produces specially coated and shaped glass for the computer touch screen industry, the company said.
Donnelly Optics Inc is based in Tucson, Arizona, and is a producer of high-quality injection molded optical lenses, Donnelly said.
Donnelly shares closed down 9/16 at 18-3/4 Friday.
